name: hoba-monorepo
description: Hiring Obstacles & Barriers Atlas — canonical repo for hoba.work
author: Dmytro Yemelianov <dmytro@hoba.work>

scripts.release: pnpm changeset version && pnpm changeset publish && pnpm validate && pnpm build
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm build:bodies && pnpm build:registry && pnpm generate:redirects && pnpm build:worker && pnpm build:discovery && pnpm --filter hoba-site build && pnpm build:cards
scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/registry-core packages/graph packages/validator packages/search packages/registry packages/cli packages/mcp && chmod +x packages/cli/dist/cli.js packages/mcp/dist/index.js
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules packages/*/dist packages/*/node_modules packages/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo apps/web/.astro apps/web/dist apps/web/node_modules
scripts.deploy:pages: pnpm build && wrangler pages deploy --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:preview: pnpm build && wrangler pages deploy --branch "$(git branch --show-current)" --commit-dirty=true
scripts.lean: pnpm build:lean && cd formal/lean && lake build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter hoba-site exec astro check --minimumSeverity error
